newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Chrysler interested in Portugal car plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler interested in Portugal car plant - paper.

text.p: U.S. carmaker Chrysler is interested in the possibility of taking control of a car factory in southern Portugal, a senior industry official was quoted as saying.

Diario de Noticias newspaper quoted Luis Rebello da Silva, president of the Sodia factory in Setubal, south of Lisbon, as saying he and Portuguese Economy Minister Augusto Mateus had discussed the matter with Chrysler officials in Brussels.
"From Chrysler's part, receptivity was good. They got to hear about the potential of the factory," Rebello da Silva told the paper in an interview.

Under an agreement reached with French carmaker Renault, the Portuguese government took over control of the factory, which employs 597 people, and agreed to continue producing Renault Clio cars until July 1998.
